concerns.analysis: On page 8 of the source PDF, there is a large, highly detailed map showing the Durham coverage zone across multiple counties (Person, Vance, Granville, Durham, Orange, Chatham, Wake, Johnston, Nash, Halifax, Wilson, Lee). This map provides meaningful visual and geographic information. However, in the HTML output, the image failed to extract properly and is missing, replaced only by a comment indicating an image without data.

concerns.analysis: The numbered list for the Agenda items spanning pages 2 through 4 is broken into multiple disconnected lists, causing the numbering to reset to 1 in the HTML rendering. Furthermore, item 9 includes its plain-text number ('9.') directly inside the list item text, which creates double-numbering when rendered as an ordered list.
